parsed.post: New best: 1.005477! Reducing batch size to 262144 yielded more optimizer updates and improved val_bpb. Next, I'll experiment with reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE further to 131072 to see if even more frequent updates can squeeze out more progress within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 131072 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training budget.
